title: 第269章 ‘深海’的威慑
slug: 德黑兰杂货铺我的情报明码标价
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

赵平安点头。

“司长，您这个分析跟张剑手底下那帮人的想法一模一样。”

“哦？”

陈建国尾音上扬，带了几分意外。

赵平安解释。

“刚才张剑的人也这么说，实在顶不住了，再往内陆撤。”

“看来他身边也有明白人啊。”

陈建国赞许地应了一声。

“不过，防患于未然。”

“平安，你记得跟张剑沟通一下。”

“撤离方案做出来后，可以也发给我一份，我可以让咱们附近的人也提前做好准备。”

“明白。”

赵平安应下。

“杜坚他们到了吧？”

陈建国问。

杜坚把手里的烟头在罐子里里摁灭，往前凑了凑。

“司长，利刃小队除骆驼还在大马士革收尾对接，其他人都已到位。”

“好。”

陈建国的语气严肃起来。

“杜坚，你们这次的任务很重。”

“张剑的身份太特殊，他手里捏着的情报网对咱们至关重要。”

“我要求你们不管出什么事，必须优先保证他的安全。”

“你们几个都是精锐，从现在开始，二十四小时轮班，给我贴身保护张剑。”

“吃饭睡觉上厕所，绝对不能让他离开你们的视线。”

屋里突然安静下来。

杜坚眨了眨眼，想说半天，愣是没想好怎么开口。

贴身保护？

他倒是也想，问题是……

他们的比试没赢啊。

陈建国在电话那头等了半天，没听到回音。

“杜坚？信号不好吗？”

“在听，司长。”

杜坚干咳了一声，声音多少带了点尴尬。

“怎么吞吞吐吐的？有困难？”

陈建国敏锐地察觉到了不对劲。

杜坚又沉默了。

他是个直性子，平时汇报工作从来不绕弯子，但这事儿实在有点难以启齿。

赵平安看着杜坚那副郁闷的模样，实在没忍住，苦笑了一声。

“司长，贴身保护这事儿吧……”

“估计有点悬了。”

“什么意思？”

陈建国的声音沉了下来。

“张剑不配合？还是他信不过咱们？”

“都有一点吧。”

Page (1/3)

Zhao Pingan nodded.

"Director, your analysis is exactly the same as the thinking of Zhang Jian's subordinates."

"Oh?"

Chen Jianguo's last note rose, which was a bit surprising.

Zhao Pingan explained.

"Zhang Jian's people said the same thing just now. They can't stand it any longer and should retreat further inland."

"It seems that there are understanding people around him."

Chen Jianguo responded with approval.

"But nip it in the bud."

"Ping An, please remember to communicate with Zhang Jian."

"After the evacuation plan is made, you can also send me a copy, and I can ask people nearby to prepare in advance."

"Understood."

Zhao Pingan agreed.

"Have Du Jian and the others arrived?"

Chen Jianguo asked.

Du Jian put out the cigarette butt in his hand in the jar and moved forward.

"Director, except for Camel, the Sharp Blade team is still finishing docking in Damascus. Everyone else is in place."

"Okay."

Chen Jianguo's tone became serious.

"Du Jian, your mission this time is very heavy."

"Zhang Jian's identity is too special, and the intelligence network he holds is crucial to us."

"I ask that no matter what happens, you must prioritize his safety."

"You are all elites. From now on, you will work in shifts 24 hours a day to protect Zhang Jian for me."

"You must never let him leave your sight when eating, sleeping or going to the bathroom."

The room suddenly became quiet.

Du Jian blinked and thought about it for a long time, but he didn't know how to speak.

Personal protection?

He did think so, but the problem was...

They didn't win the competition.

Chen Jianguo waited on the other end of the phone for a long time but did not hear a reply.

"Du Jian? Is the signal bad?"

"Listening, Director."

Du Jian coughed dryly, his voice somewhat embarrassed.

"Why are you hesitating? Are you having difficulty?"

Chen Jianguo was keenly aware that something was wrong.

Du Jian was silent again.

He is a straight-tempered person and never makes any detours when reporting on work, but this matter is really hard to talk about.

Looking at Du Jian's depressed look, Zhao Ping'an couldn't help but smiled bitterly.

"Director, please protect this matter personally..."

"I guess it's a bit confusing."

"What do you mean?"

Chen Jianguo's voice deepened.

"Zhang Jian won't cooperate? Or does he not trust us?"

"A little bit of both."
